verdict.rationale: Martin's own docs describe proactive AI outputs drawn from the user's data: daily or weekly briefings, proactively drafted emails, automatic email labeling with follow-up actions, and morning calls covering the user's schedule. These are one-line claims, briefing content is never described as data-derived insights, and delivery is through email or phone rather than an in-product insights view. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights or suggestions briefings contain, an in-app insights surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Martin can send you daily or weekly briefings via email.
Martin can proactively draft emails for you and send them on your behalf.
Martin can automatically label your emails and take follow up actions on your behalf.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
